content: React Router v8 (June 2026) removed the react-router-dom compat package entirely; import core APIs from 'react-router' and browser-specific bits (RouterProvider/HydratedRouter) from 'react-router/dom'. v7 kept react-router-dom as a re-export shim. Three modes exist: declarative, data, framework - Data mode (createBrowserRouter) is the appropriate choice for a Vite SPA needing nested/dynamic routes without full framework/SSR features.
